To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the VTR 2001-2003 has had a positive impact on student enrollments in Italian universities.

(i) the VTR had a positive impact on student enrollment decisions; (ii) this positive effect is stronger for students with higher entry qualifications and for universities that are in the top quartiles of the VTR distribution; (iii) the effect is larger for new universities, which have a lower established reputation; (iv) effects appear similar in all macro regions (Northern, Central, Southern and Islands) but precise estimates are available only for universities in the Northern region.
